## Error handler
Attached as `settings.errorWorkflow` on the other GTMOS workflows. When one of them fails, this receives the Error Trigger payload and records a structured operational record in GTMOS (`/api/v1/webhooks/n8n`, HMAC-signed) so a failure is durable and queryable instead of living only in n8n's execution list.

Deliberately notifies **nothing external** — no email, no Slack. The record is data, not an alert; GTMOS owns alerting. It also stamps `$execution.customData` so an operator can filter n8n executions by the failing workflow.
